OPTIONS_HELP.TITLE: How to use options & add-ons
OPTIONS_HELP.STEP1_TEXT: by clicking its name below (e.g. Burger, Pizza).
OPTIONS_HELP.STEP2_TEXT: (e.g. “Size”, “Sauce”, “Drink”): give it a name, choose Single choice (customer selects one option) or Multiple choice (several options), enable “Required” if the customer must choose, then click Add.
OPTIONS_HELP.STEP3_TEXT: inside each group: open the group (arrow), enter the name (e.g. “Large”, “Spicy”), add a price in DT if needed (0 = no extra), check “Default” for the pre-selected option, then click +.
OPTIONS_HELP.EXAMPLE: Example: product “Burger” → group “Size” (single choice, required) with options Small, Medium, Large (+5 DT).
